name: Neverending AI Storybook
detailed_description:
🛠️ Before You Dive In: Check Your Specs

Neverending AI Storybook runs all its AI magic right on your machine—which means:

🎮 You’ll need a dedicated GPU with 8GB VRAM or more, like an RTX 2060 or RX 6600.
🔥 Bonus: It works on both NVIDIA and AMD cards, so don’t worry if you're rocking a Radeon.
🧠 A fast SSD is also helpful but not required—this thing moves big models around (2.5GB+) and needs fast storage to keep up.

We support a wide range of cards from roughly 2020 and onward, so if you’ve got a fairly recent gaming rig, you're probably good!

A Story That Writes Itself—And It's All Yours

Every adventure is unique. Every image is AI-crafted. All of it happens on your PC.
No servers. No subscriptions. Just endless storytelling, powered by local AI that responds to your imagination.

Features:

• 🧠 Fully local, private AI-generated stories — no internet required

• 🖼️ AI-generated art for every scene, with customizable visual styles

• ⚖️ Your choices matter: pick from actions or type your own

• 🎮 No subscriptions, no limits — just unlimited adventures

• 🔒 100% private — nothing leaves your machine

• 🪛 Load your own AI Text models — supports GGUF via llama.cpp

• ⚙️ Powered by llama.cpp & Stable Diffusion — zero setup required

• 🧩 Works with both NVIDIA and AMD GPUs (see system requirements)

Want to be a space pirate? A noir detective? A wizard in a cyberpunk apocalypse?

Whatever you can imagine, it becomes the story.

A book that never ends—unless you want it to.

Neverending AI Storybook is your personal AI-powered storyteller, generating unique tales, stunning illustrations, and interactive choices based on your input. No two adventures are ever the same!

Privacy-first storytelling—no limits, no internet, just adventure.

Shape your own adventure with a local AI that crafts fully customized stories, complete with AI-generated images and dynamic choices — 100% private with no internet required.

AI-powered storytelling, built for you.

Ever wished a story could adapt to your imagination? In Neverending AI Storybook, the AI reacts to your ideas, crafting unique tales with stunning illustrations at every turn.

• One moment, you’re a pirate captain navigating treacherous waters; the next, you're doing karate on the 9/11 hijackers. What will your next adventure be?

• With every decision you make, the AI weaves a deeper narrative, ensuring no two journeys are alike, even with the same premise.

• Don’t just read a story—become part of an ever-expanding world that reshapes itself with every page!

• Whether you want a relaxing bedtime tale or an epic fantasy saga, Neverending AI Storybook delivers an experience that feels handcrafted just for you.

Infinite Storytelling Possibilities

• Every session is a brand-new adventure—AI dynamically generates unique stories based on your input.

• Choose from preset story genres or create something entirely original.

• Your choices matter! Pick from three suggested actions or type your own to shape the narrative however you like.

AI-Generated Illustrations

• Watch as the game paints a scene for every page, using AI-generated imagery to match the unfolding story.

• From medieval castles to dystopian wastelands, each setting is brought to life with unique AI-crafted visuals.

Offline & Private – Your Stories Stay Yours

• Runs entirely locally on your machine—no online servers, no data collection, no tracking.

• Your adventures are 100% private, ensuring that your creativity remains yours alone.

• No subscriptions, no microtransactions—just unlimited storytelling at your fingertips.

Pick the AI model that fits your system

Neverending AI Storybook scales to fit your hardware. Whether you have a mid-range gaming laptop or a high-end desktop, you can select the AI model that balances speed, creativity, and accuracy. You can even disable image generation for maximum speed.

✔ 8GB VRAM (RTX 2060, RX 6600 or better) – Runs smaller models for quick storytelling.

✔ 12GB+ VRAM (RTX 3060, 3070, or better) – A great balance of quality and speed.

✔ 24GB+ VRAM (RTX 4090, 3090, or equivalent) – For the most expressive AI-generated stories.

No need for cloud servers or subscriptions—everything runs right on your machine.

Just pick a model that fits your setup and start generating stories!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.5 Ghz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8GB Dedicated VRAM (RTX 2060, RX 6600, or better) – Supports smaller AI models for faster performance.
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 3.5 Ghz
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 12GB+ Dedicated VRAM (RTX 3060, 3070, or better) – Enjoy a balance of speed and creativity.
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Additional Disk Space recommended for more models

content_descriptors.notes: Neverending AI Storybook generates dynamic, interactive stories based on player input, with strict guardrails to ensure content remains appropriate. The AI does not generate sexually explicit material or extreme content. If inappropriate input is detected, the AI will either redirect the story to a safe narrative or refuse to generate content altogether. This ensures a safe and respectful storytelling experience for all players.
